svg.desc: Line 1, Vadodara → anywhere: my route so far, drawn as a transit map. Stations: Parul University (Computer Science · Vadodara); Co-founded DualMind Labs (2025 · with Rishi A. Bangoriya); DualMind Arena goes live (Blind AI model evaluation · 5,000+ request spike handled); a loop of things built at events — ModVigil (Reddit Mod Tools Hackathon 2026), PixelProof (Next Byte Hacks V2), AI Component Builder (Cursor workshop, Rajkot); you are here — Now: AI agents & automations; the road ahead — Next: AI agent evaluation; terminus: Anywhere.
